text.description_html:
Weslock 1315/1305, Colonial Dummy Handleset with Two Faux Cylinders

The solid brass exterior of the Colonial Dual Keyed Dummy Handleset features a textured antique brass finish. It has just enough beautiful detail to make it a point of interest for your door while adding an early American style to your home. It comes with your choice of inside handle style. This dummy handleset is non-locking and non-latching making the dual key holes just for show. This entrance set does not latch nor lock--dummy handlesets such as this one are usually used on the inactive side of double doors.

Dual Keyed Dummy Cylinder Handleset: The deadbolt as well as the lock on the exterior handle underneath the deadbolt do not function. This handleset neither latches nor locks and is usually used on the inactive side of double doors.

Also available matching:
Colonial Dual Keyed Single Cylinder Handleset
Colonial Dual Keyed Double Cylinder Handleset

This classically designed handleset is from the Weslock Traditionale Collection which features solid brass construction and lifetime mechanical and finish warranties.

Features of the Weslock Dual Keyed Colonial Dummy Handleset:

  • Solid brass exterior.
  • Removable knobs prevents scratching during installation.
  • Limited Lifetime Mechanical Warranty
  • Limited Lifetime Finish Warranty

Specifications of the Traditionale Series Colonial Dual Keyed Dummy Handleset:

  • Finish: Antique Brass
  • Exterior Handle Length: 19-1/2"
  • Exterior Handle Projection: 3-3/8"
  • Exterior Plate Width: 3-1/16"

The finish for the inside knob you choose will be Antique Brass to match the handleset.
